about.title: Pioneering Computer Vision for a Sustainable Future.
about.intro: As an AI Engineer, my core passion lies at the intersection of **Computer Vision** and **Object Detection**. I believe that advanced neural networks can solve some of the most critical challenges in various domains. Image shown on left is myself presenting my research on **Ganoderma fungus detection** at the 2024 Focus Group Discussion of Research and Community Service Disemination by Mulawarman University.
about.detailed: My work is deeply rooted in practical application. I've developed specialized vision systems for **detecting Ganoderma fungus** in oil palm trees, a critical threat to palm health, and implemented robust algorithms for **counting oil palm fruit bunches** to optimize yield estimation. Beyond agriculture, my expertise extends to **medical imaging**, where I've contributed to projects that enhance diagnostic accuracy through AI-driven image analysis, such as identifying **glaucoma disease** in eye medical scans.
